story.vex: Let your guard down. I can wait. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED, in principle: the crew logs the true cost of the siege before anyone forgets it. Astro: "Now every cadet can see it in numbers, not just in memory."

files./home/cadet/citadel/README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Before this review closes, read incident-cost.txt and sort each line into its cost category: financial, legal, trust, or operational.

1. cat incident-cost.txt
2. echo <item> <category> >> findings.txt for each of the four lines
files./home/cadet/citadel/incident-cost.txt:
AFTER-ACTION COST REPORT
-------------------------
cost-shield-repair    12,000 credits to repair the shield generator
cost-breach-notice    Codexia regulators require a breach report within 10 days
cost-ally-trust       Three allied crews now double-check every Citadel report
cost-mission-pause    Missions paused for a week during cleanup

steps.title: Read the after-action report
steps.body: Astro: "Read it before you sort it." `cat incident-cost.txt`.

steps.title: Volt's Ledger: sort the damage
steps.body: Volt: "Four lines, four categories. Sort them so command can see the shape of it." Use `echo cost-shield-repair financial >> findings.txt`, `echo cost-breach-notice legal >> findings.txt`, `echo cost-ally-trust trust >> findings.txt`, and `echo cost-mission-pause operational >> findings.txt`. (`echo` prints text and `>>` adds it to the end of a file, so each answer becomes one line of findings.txt.)
